name: IntentGrantPresent
description: Whether a user-consented intent grant (RFC 9396 authorization_details) is bound to the presenting token. Default false — an omitted value means NO grant was proven (fail closed).

name: IntentGrantConsented
description: Whether a human approved this grant interactively at authorization time, as opposed to the client asserting it. Default false — client-asserted intent is not user consent.

name: IntentGrantExpired
description: Whether the grant is past its validity window. Computed by the caller (P1AZ conditions have no attested time arithmetic). Default TRUE — an unknown grant lifetime is treated as expired.

name: IntentGrantAction
description: The single action the grant authorizes, from authorization_details[].actions (e.g. "transfer"). One action per decision — a multi-action grant is evaluated once per action.

name: IntentGrantPayee
description: The counterparty the grant authorizes, from authorization_details[].payee. Empty when the granted action has no counterparty (e.g. a read).

name: IntentGrantMaxAmount
description: The value ceiling the grant authorizes, from authorization_details[].amount. Default 0 — a grant that states no cap authorizes no value (fail closed).

name: IntentGrantRef
description: Opaque reference to the grant for audit: the PAR request_uri, or the grant/consent id. Not used in any condition — carried so a decision can be traced back to the consent that authorized it.

name: IntentBindingMethod
description: How intent reached this decision: "par-rar" (user-consented, RFC 9126 + 9396), "intent-token" (client-asserted), or "none". Provenance for audit; not used in any condition.

name: IntentRequestAction
description: The action the agent is attempting now (the tool/operation being invoked). Compared against IntentGrantAction.

name: IntentRequestPayee
description: The counterparty of the attempted action. Compared against IntentGrantPayee.

name: IntentRequestAmount
description: The value of the attempted action. Compared against IntentGrantMaxAmount.

name: IntentRequestMutating
description: Whether the attempted action changes state. Intent governance applies only to mutating actions. Default TRUE — an unclassified action is treated as mutating (fail closed).

name: IntentDriftScore
description: Optional 0..1 semantic-drift score from an external evaluator comparing the original request to the proposed action. Default 0 (no drift asserted), so this policy behaves identically when no scorer is deployed.

name: GrantPresent
description: A user-consented intent grant is bound to the token.

name: ActionIsMutating
description: The attempted action changes state. Reads are governed by scope policy, not by intent.

name: IntentGoverned
description: Gate for every drift rule: a grant exists AND the action mutates state. Without this gate, a read performed under a transfer grant would fail the action-drift comparison.

name: NoGrantForMutatingAction
description: A state-changing action is attempted with no intent grant bound to the token at all.

name: GrantExpiredInScope
description: The grant that would authorize this action is past its validity window.

name: GrantNotUserConsented
description: The grant was asserted by the client rather than approved by a human.

name: ActionDrift
description: The attempted action is not the action the user consented to.

name: PayeeDrift
description: The attempted counterparty is not the counterparty the user consented to.

name: AmountDrift
description: The attempted value exceeds the ceiling the user consented to.

name: SemanticDriftSuspected
description: An external evaluator scored this action as materially diverging from the original request, above 0.5, while still inside the grant envelope.

name: Intent — No Grant Bound
description: The agent attempted a state-changing action with no user-consented intent grant on the token.
payload: {"denied":true,"reason":"intent_grant_missing","message":"Action '{{a1c70001-0000-4000-8000-000000000009}}' changes state but no user-consented intent grant is bound to this token. Obtain authorization_details via PAR and have the user approve them.","action":"{{a1c70001-0000-4000-8000-000000000009}}","bindingMethod":"{{a1c70001-0000-4000-8000-000000000008}}"}

name: Intent — Grant Expired
description: The intent grant is outside its validity window; consent must be refreshed.
payload: {"denied":true,"reason":"intent_grant_expired","message":"The intent grant authorizing '{{a1c70001-0000-4000-8000-000000000009}}' has expired. The user must re-consent before the agent may continue.","grantRef":"{{a1c70001-0000-4000-8000-000000000007}}"}

name: Intent — Not User Consented
description: The grant was client-asserted rather than approved by a human. Self-asserted intent is not consent.
payload: {"denied":true,"reason":"intent_not_consented","message":"The intent grant for '{{a1c70001-0000-4000-8000-000000000009}}' was asserted by the client, not approved by the user. A state-changing action requires human-consented authorization_details.","bindingMethod":"{{a1c70001-0000-4000-8000-000000000008}}"}

name: Intent — Action Drift
description: The attempted action differs from the consented action. This is the canonical intent-drift denial.

name: Intent — Payee Drift
description: The attempted counterparty differs from the consented counterparty — the classic injected-payee substitution.

name: Intent — Amount Drift
description: The attempted value exceeds the consented ceiling.

name: Intent — Re-consent Required
description: Obligation: the action is inside the grant envelope but an evaluator flagged semantic divergence. Re-confirm with the user before executing.
payload: {"obligation":"RECONSENT","reason":"intent_semantic_drift","message":"Action '{{a1c70001-0000-4000-8000-000000000009}}' is within the granted envelope but diverges from the original request (drift {{a1c70001-0000-4000-8000-000000000013}}). Re-confirm intent with the user before executing.","driftScore":"{{a1c70001-0000-4000-8000-000000000013}}","grantRef":"{{a1c70001-0000-4000-8000-000000000007}}"}

name: Intent — Within Grant
description: Catch-all approval: the action falls inside the user-consented grant, or intent governance does not apply (a read).

name: Intent Deny — No Grant Bound
description: DENY a state-changing action when no user-consented intent grant is bound to the token.

name: Intent Deny — Grant Expired
description: DENY when the grant authorizing this action is outside its validity window.

name: Intent Deny — Not User Consented
description: DENY when the grant was client-asserted rather than approved by a human.

name: Intent Deny — Action Drift
description: DENY when the attempted action is not the action the user consented to. The canonical intent-drift rule.

name: Intent Deny — Payee Drift
description: DENY when the attempted counterparty is not the one the user consented to.

name: Intent Deny — Amount Drift
description: DENY when the attempted value exceeds the consented ceiling.

name: Intent Permit — Re-consent on Semantic Drift
description: PERMIT with a RECONSENT obligation when an external evaluator scores the action as diverging, though it remains inside the grant. Inert unless a scorer supplies IntentDriftScore.

name: Intent Permit — Within Grant
description: Catch-all PERMIT. Required so an action matching no explicit rule resolves cleanly instead of INDETERMINATE.

name: Agent Intent Governance
description: Evaluates every state-changing AI agent action against the RFC 9396 authorization_details the user consented to (pushed via RFC 9126 PAR) and bound to the presenting token. The PDP receives the grant and the request as separate facts and compares them itself. Denies on missing grant, expired grant, client-asserted (non-consented) grant, and action/payee/amount drift; optionally raises a re-consent obligation on scored semantic drift. Reads are out of scope and fall through to the catch-all permit.

name: PingOne Authorize — Agent Intent Governance
description: Root policy set for intent-based access control of AI agents. Contains: Agent Intent Governance. Standalone and self-contained — it shares no attributes, conditions, statements or IDs with other packages in the environment, so it can be imported alongside existing policy sets.
